roles.title: Data Analyst
roles.description: Healthcare claims analytics in Snowflake and AWS environments, supporting operational reporting, utilization metrics and KPI monitoring with analytics, product and operations teams.
highlights: Build and maintain claims-based data extracts and analytics pipelines in Snowflake and AWS, processing over 8M+ healthcare claim records annually.
Write and optimize complex SQL in Snowflake and Athena, including joins, window functions, performance tuning, pipeline automation and quarterly data refreshes.
Automate recurring reporting and reconciliation workflows with SQL, Python and dbt, reducing manual reporting preparation effort by approximately 35%.
Develop performance measures and cohort analysis models in SQL and Python to identify utilization trends and claims-based patterns.
Investigate data quality issues and metric discrepancies, documenting methodology, sources and assumptions for auditable, repeatable reporting.
Prepare curated datasets for Power BI reporting and apply anomaly detection with Python and Scikit-learn.

roles.title: Junior Data Analyst
roles.description: Reporting and dashboards for manufacturing operations, inventory and supply-chain stakeholders, working with operational and IT teams.
highlights: Built and maintained SQL-based data extracts and performance measures for manufacturing operations, inventory and supply-chain reporting.
Developed Tableau and Power BI dashboards for production and compliance stakeholders to monitor batch-processing efficiency and operational KPIs.
Translated business specifications into analytical SQL logic and reusable validation queries, reducing recurring metric discrepancies by approximately 25%.
Built Python-based ETL utilities for data transformation and pipeline automation, reducing manual reporting effort by approximately 30%.
Investigated data-quality issues and maintained auditable methodology, data-source and reporting documentation.

roles.title: Data Analyst Trainee
roles.description: Data extraction, analysis and dashboards on customer, lending and transactional datasets supporting repayment analytics and KPI reporting.
highlights: Performed SQL-based extraction and analysis on customer, lending and transactional datasets containing over 2M+ records to support repayment analytics and KPI reporting.
Developed Tableau and Power BI dashboards tracking repayment behavior, delinquency trends and lending performance benchmarks.
Built Python data transformation and automation scripts using Pandas and NumPy, and assisted with Snowflake and Amazon Redshift environments.
Maintained reporting documentation, KPI definitions and data-governance records while collaborating with analytics and operations teams.
